intl-tel-input v29.0.5
Fetched: 2026-06-10
Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/intl-tel-input@29.0.5/dist/

Files vendored:
  js/intlTelInput.min.js  — classic IIFE bundle, exposes window.intlTelInput

  css/intlTelInput.min.css
  img/flags.webp          — flag sprites, referenced relatively by intlTelInput.min.css (img/ must stay a sibling of css/)

No globe image — v29 uses inline SVG for icons.
